_about: Commander magic attacks by rarity. Owner: Role Building. The commander holds one at a time and casts it automatically when its mana is full. Each ghost-fight win offers one: take it (the old one is deleted) or sacrifice it for 1 extra brand next Raid. Learned attacks last the run; a Legendary learned once joins the player's unlock pool. Rules are from the design doc; every attack and number below is PROPOSED. Each attack's look is a code effect (Arena), cast on one generic commander clip (Animations).

casting.note: The design says the commander casts automatically mid-fight; PROPOSED that it fills a mana bar like any fighter, so players can read when the cast is coming.

offer.boost_rule: A boss's loot boost multiplies that rarity's weight, as for relics.
offer.note: Design: streaks raise Epic and Legendary odds slightly. At the cap a hot streak takes Legendary from 3% to about 5%.

spark_toss.name: Spark Toss
spark_toss.text: Hurls a spark at the current target for 200% attack damage as magic.

stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
stone_skin.text: The commander gains a shield worth 25% of its max HP for 4 s.

rallying_cry.name: Rallying Cry
rallying_cry.text: Allies within 2 hexes gain 15% attack speed for 4 s.

pebble_volley.name: Pebble Volley
pebble_volley.text: Three stones strike random enemies for 80% attack damage each.

root_snare.name: Root Snare
root_snare.text: Vines grip the target and one enemy beside it: 120% as magic and rooted for 1.5 s.

mending_light.name: Mending Light
mending_light.text: Heals the most hurt ally for 20% of its max HP and the commander for 10%.

flame_ring.name: Flame Ring
flame_ring.text: A ring of flame hits every adjacent enemy for 150% as magic and burns it for 2 s.

gale_lance.name: Gale Lance
gale_lance.text: A spear of wind pierces 4 hexes: 220% as magic, knocking each enemy up for 1.0 s.

sigil_ward.name: Sigil Ward
sigil_ward.text: Every ally gains a shield worth 15% of its max HP for 4 s.

thunder_clap.name: Thunder Clap
thunder_clap.text: Claps thunder: enemies within 1 hex take 120% as magic and are stunned for 1.5 s.

meteor_brand.name: Meteor Brand
meteor_brand.text: A glowing sigil-meteor lands on the healthiest enemy: 350% as magic around it, then burns.

war_banner.name: War Banner
war_banner.text: Plants a banner: all allies gain 25% attack damage and 15% attack speed for 6 s.

tidal_pull.name: Tidal Pull
tidal_pull.text: Drags the 3 farthest enemies toward the commander: 150% as magic and stunned for 1.0 s.

verdict_of_the_pit.name: Verdict of the Pit
verdict_of_the_pit.text: Every enemy takes 15% of its max HP as true damage and is stunned for 1.0 s.

aurora_gate.name: Aurora Gate
aurora_gate.text: All allies heal 30% of their max HP and shake off stuns, roots, slows and burns.

storm_of_brands.name: Storm of Brands
storm_of_brands.text: Six sigils strike random enemies for 180% as magic each and slow them for 2 s.
